invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Iterator, either from super.handleUpdate(...) or Collections.singletonList(...).iterator().
fileId is passed through from the method argument and is used in logging and object creation without a null check, indicating it must be non-null.
partitionPath is used as an argument and passed into constructors without a null check, suggesting it must be non-null.
recordItr is passed as a method argument and used in object construction, so it must be non-null.
result is always a valid Iterator and must either have elements or not, capturing totality.
